name: Nutmeg
description: Warm sweet grating spice; sedative in large doses.

ayurveda.note: Given in warm milk for sleep.

histamine.note: Pinch amounts fine; large doses are toxic regardless.

effects.note: A pinch stirred into warm milk before bed is a long-standing South Asian and Middle Eastern folk remedy for sleep, but the pharmacology behind it is weak and larger amounts are toxic, which keeps this reading contested rather than established. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
